advisory_text: Maintain 2-5cm standing water in rice fields. Monitor for Stem Borer infestation.
recommended_practice: Apply Cartap Hydrochloride 4G @ 10kg/acre if dead hearts exceed 5%.

advisory_text: Avoid nitrogenous fertilizer excess. Monitor for pink bollworm larval entry.
recommended_practice: Install Pheromone traps @ 5 traps/acre for adult monitoring.

advisory_text: First irrigation at Crown Root Initiation (20-25 days after sowing) is crucial.
recommended_practice: Apply top dressing of Urea (45kg/acre) after first irrigation.

advisory_text: Watch out for Fall Armyworm (FAW) whorl damage.
recommended_practice: Whorl application of Neem cake or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L.

advisory_text: High relative humidity (>85%) and temperature between 10-20°C favors Late Blight.
recommended_practice: Prophylactic spray of Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2g/L.

advisory_text: Stake tomato vines to prevent soil-borne fungal pathogens.
recommended_practice: Foliar spray of 1% Potassium Nitrate to boost fruit setting.
